title: Was Egypt’s desert once a shark-filled sea? Scientists uncover ancient ‘graveyard’
description: Scientists have uncovered a 100-million-year-old shark graveyard in Egypt’s desert, with teeth from seven species revealing a once-thriving marine ecosystem along northern Africa.

title: 5 Ancient Food Preservation Methods That Keep Food Fresh Without a Fridge
description: Ancient food preservation methods offer sustainable alternatives to modern refrigeration. Lactic acid fermentation transforms vegetables into nutrient-rich, probiotic-filled foods. Drying and dehydration remove moisture, extending the shelf life of produce naturally. Traditional curing and salting solutions preserve meats and vegetables effectively for extended periods. Embracing these low-tech strategies builds a self-sufficient kitchen and honours culinary heritage.
